about_text.value: Along the archipelago signal towers of Mistmere, chronicler envoy Lumen-9 tracks multi-hop lantern ciphers among six scholarly wardens and two outer-ring beacon guilds. From single-step watch reports to twelve-hop delegated cipher chains and three-way parity pacts, every turn scales reasoning depth while keeping constitutional recall in human hands.
